subject.title: fix(config): use Object.hasOwn for own-key checks in write-prepare helpers

question: Should this branch be narrowed to only the config own-key fix while the security-audit changes continue in the dedicated security PRs?
rationale: The branch mixes a bounded config bug fix with protected security-audit contract changes that already have separate open PRs and an unresolved upgrade false-negative blocker.

options.title: Narrow To Config Only
options.body: Drop the inherited security-audit commit, keep the focused config helper/test change, and require real config-write proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt The Broader Security Scope Here
options.body: Use this PR as the security-audit landing path only after fixing stale-registry handling, reconciling the duplicate audit PRs, and adding real audit CLI proof.

options.title: Pause Until Security PRs Resolve
options.body: Hold this PR until the dedicated audit work lands or closes, then re-review the remaining config-only diff.

recommendation.title: Narrow To Config Only
recommendation.body: Drop the inherited security-audit commit, keep the focused config helper/test change, and require real config-write proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is about protected security-audit contract scope, and this person has the strongest feature-history signal for that audit surface.
